title: WEB Designer
description:
Company Details:

Founded in 1999, Wizie.com is a trusted name in Travel Technology, delivering cutting-edge solutions such as Booking Engines, GDS Connectivity, PNR Management, and Automation tools.

We work with Airlines, OTAs, Travel Agencies, and Loyalty Programs worldwide, powering their digital transformation journeys.

We’re now expanding our B2C and B2B marketing initiatives for Australia-based tour packages and local travel experiences and are looking for a PPC-first Digital Marketer to scale these efforts.

**JOB DETAILS:**

**Position:** WEB Developer

**Working days:** 5 days working (work from office only)

**Office Timings :** 12:30-9:30PM

**Essential Skills :**

* Scripting Language: HTML5, CSS3/SCSS/SASS, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, CMS.
* **Software’s: Adobe Dreamweaver , Photoshop, XD, Figma**
* Exposure to Search Engine Optimization (SEO) will be preferred.
* Work experience in travel domain would be an added advantage.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have Experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Figma, and Photoshop?
* What is your current CTC?

Experience:

* Web design: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: UI/UX Designer
